title: Foundations: Alt Rock - The Complete Guide
summary: What Alt Rock is, where it came from, and how its songs work.
body:
Alt Rock songs: Alternative rock was the 1980s–90s underground made mainstream: jangly R.E.M. guitars, Pixies' quiet-loud dynamics, and Nirvana's explosion. College radio's revenge on the mainstream.

History: R.E.M., the Pixies, and Sonic Youth built the indie circuit; Nirvana's Nevermind (1991) broke it worldwide. Pearl Jam, Radiohead, and the Smashing Pumpkins carried the 1990s.

How the songs work: Alt Rock favors the keys of E, G, D, A. Common forms include Quiet verse, explosive chorus (the Pixies formula); Build-and-release dynamics. Players should master the quiet-loud shift: clean arpeggios to distorted roar first, then drop-d tuning for heavier riffs. Varies; drop-D for grunge weight.
